summary: Uses Nvidia Maxine AR face tracking to detect faces, landmarks, confidence, rotations, and optional fitted face-mesh transforms from a TOP image.
key_concepts: Uses Nvidia Maxine AR SDK models to detect a face from a TOP image and output bounding boxes, rotations, landmarks, and confidence channels.
When multiple faces are visible, the documented behavior is to track the largest detected face rather than all faces.
Landmark output can be disabled or set to 68 or 126 points, with optional confidence values for assessing detection quality.
Mesh Transform output works with a compatible Nvidia nvf face mesh and Face Track SOP to align a fitted 3D face mesh.
For image-aligned 3D overlays, the docs recommend orthographic camera alignment with bottom-left origin and Aspect Correct UVs enabled.

common_gotchas: Official docs list this operator as Windows-only.
It requires an Nvidia RTX 20, 30, 40, or 50 series GPU and Nvidia Maxine AR SDK models.
The AI model files are not bundled in a way a planner can assume; validate the model folder before relying on output.
If multiple faces are visible, the CHOP attempts to track the largest detected face.
Mesh fitting requires a compatible nvf mesh file; older mesh files may not work with current TouchDesigner builds.
For image-aligned 3D rendering, use an orthographic camera with bottom-left origin and aspect-correct UVs.
